I've been using Svelte / SvelteKit for 1.5 years now – it is without comparison the most enjoyable and productive web framework/language I've ever used.
Svelte Stores and the Context system are especially great for sharing state, and the app feels snappy... I've also been happy to find that its generated code is pretty readable.
Svelte doesn't support JSX/TSX though =( ... Svelte is close enough to Vue with 'script setup' mode anyways, the major difference is whether your logic/keywords go INSIDE the HTML tags or OUTSIDE.

there is just something more appealing working with less higher-level abstractions... Sure though would wish SvelteKit was at the same level with Next.js. Fixing dev server errors is a little distracting at times.
I've grown pessimistic about [frontend frameworks] in general, but I'm enthusiastic about Svelte because it does so many things right... Interacting with the Svelte compiler is ridiculously easy.
I've been pretty skeptical about SPAs but having tried out Svelte for a few side projects... Svelte looks really awesome and the simplicity it brings back is invaluable.
